subject: general
question:
Select the correct spelling of the underlined word in the given sentence.

He made a __sureptitiuos __phone call while his boss was out of the room.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. surreptitious.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"surreptitious"** means something that is done in a secret or stealthy way to avoid detection. (गुप्त)

 
 
• **Example:** He made a surreptitious phone call while his boss was out of the room.
 
 
 
• **"Sureptitiuos"** is an incorrect spelling of the word "surreptitious". (ग़लत वर्तनी)
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: He made a sureptitiuos phone call while his boss was out of the room.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. surreptitious.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Surreptitous** (ग़लत वर्तनी): This is an incorrect spelling of "surreptitious".

 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: He made a surreptitous phone call while his boss was out of the room.
 
 
 
• **Sureptitious** (ग़लत वर्तनी): This is also an incorrect spelling of "surreptitious".
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: He made a sureptitious phone call while his boss was out of the room.
 
 
 
• **Sarreptitious** (ग़लत वर्तनी): This is another incorrect spelling of "surreptitious".
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: He made a sarreptitious phone call while his boss was out of the room.
